claim.why_it_matters: A section heading demoted to plain text drops it from the document structure, so heading-based navigation and section slicing miss the clause boundary.
claim.note: Printed as a section heading (sibling of '### 3.9.2 General Format' on page 602); the markdown renders it as a plain paragraph with no heading marker.

verdict.reasoning: The printed page 603 sets '3.9.3 Syntax Rules' as a numbered clause heading at the left margin, the same form as the other subclause headings. In specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md the Report Writer report group description entry has '### 3.9.1 Function' (line 22700) and '### 3.9.2 General Format' (line 22704) as headings, but page 603 carries '3.9.3 Syntax Rules' as a plain paragraph with no '###' marker. The text is present, so no wording is lost, but the clause boundary is missing from the heading structure. Structural severity is correct.
